revision_selection.objective: Select exact maintained source, target, and QEMU revisions for the frozen driver scope. Every evidence excerpt must be one byte-for-byte contiguous substring of the retrieved source; never join fragments or use ellipses. Include at least one cross-repository compatibility citation whose bindings contain all three selected source, target, and QEMU refs. Return only the revision-selection proposal required by the output schema.

evidence_closure.objective: Propose the minimum evidence closure covering the source, target, QEMU, hardware, test, and tooling domains. Return only the evidence-closure proposal required by the output schema.

environment_recovery.objective: Select one concrete, least-cost QEMU/QMP experiment route from the frozen repositories and host inventory. Return only one schema_version=2 environment experiment plan.

knowledge_base.objective: Create the mandatory target-specific knowledge probe plan from controlled originals. If compliance_recheck is present, revise the complete plan to close every KNOWLEDGE finding using directly inspected target originals. Return only one schema_version=1 object containing the complete probes array.

target_platform_study.objective: Complete the target-platform study from pinned originals. Cover the full target API closure expected by the design: public interfaces, concrete wrapper implementations, framework-owned helper types, deferred work, allocation and timing facilities, and every lock, IRQ, I/O, blocking, cleanup, and failure-path dependency reached by the analogous lifecycle. Each API-table entry must have original definition and call-site evidence. Every proposed pre-existing target change must name one or more stable planned driver_contract_ids that Phase 4 will define; omit changes that no driver contract requires. If compliance_recheck is present, close every KNOWLEDGE finding and update all affected profile, API-table, trace, and change-plan records. Return only one JSON object with profile_json, profile_markdown, api_table, analogous_trace, and change_plan.

source_closure.objective: Close the behaviorally required source set using the frozen compile commands. Return only one source-closure JSON object for the controller to verify.

migration_contracts.objective: Build the Phase 4 evidence-backed migration contract set and define every driver_contract_id predeclared by the target change plan. For target evidence, pair the same api_id with definition and call_site objects copied exactly from that API-table entry's definition_evidence and call_site_evidence; never rewrite or invent a locator. For hardware, source, and QEMU evidence, use knowledge search/show and copy existing chunk_id and record_id values; never construct IDs or widen line ranges. Do not create a knowledge gap for an API already resolved as VERIFIED or INFERRED. Return only schema_version=1 JSON with contracts and gaps; each contract must contain id, requirement, four evidence lanes, source_function_refs, rust_design_intent, verification, evidence_status, and execution_status.

test_adaptation.objective: Build the Phase 5 public developer test-selection matrix. Return only schema_version=1 JSON with tests. Each test requires test_id, origin, source_test, primary_class, disposition, rationale, evidence, contract_ids, original_command, setup, stimulus, oracle, boundary_cases, negative_paths, cleanup, source_only_assertions_removed, adapter, limitations, expected_result, execution_status, and public_developer_evidence.

driver_implementation.objective: Implement Phase 6 directly in the writable target worktree. For a compliance repair, fix only the supplied findings and use implementation_baseline for unchanged metadata. Return schema_version=2 JSON with file_roles (path and role only) plus coverage, target_changes, target_symbols, and unsafe_obligations; set an unchanged metadata collection to null so the controller inherits it. The controller derives changed paths, file hashes, and structured source facts. Do not build or run QEMU in this stage.

target_compliance.objective: Perform only Skill Phase 7 against the current implementation and pinned target originals. Recheck the supplied repair findings, then review the Skill-listed target concerns. Do not inspect Driver Port Factory source/tests, edit, compile, run QEMU, or plan Phase 8. Return only the compliance_report required by the output schema; execution is NOT_RUN. Current violations must name IMPLEMENTATION or KNOWLEDGE repair and target-original evidence.

artifact_preparation.objective: Plan only Skill Phase 8 artifact preparation for the current writable target tree. Use the target's evidenced build/package route and return the plan required by the output schema. Build and inspect commands must not calculate file hashes or write the presence manifest; the controller owns hashes, changed paths, and the manifest.

public_qemu_validation.objective: Freeze the public Phase 8 QEMU evidence plan for the current runtime artifact. Return only schema_version=1 JSON with runs and the complete ordered ladder. Bind every run to the provided artifact, implementation, packaged-test and environment-route identities; cover every QEMU contract and retained/adapted public test. Each run defines qemu, stimulus and external checker argv without shell syntax, device/topology/CPU/memory/backend, predeclared oracle, cleanup, controls and pinned QEMU-original evidence. Use EXECUTE, FROZEN_PREREQUISITE, NOT_APPLICABLE or BLOCKED honestly; do not include private tests.

public_repair.objective: Perform exactly one bounded Phase 9 diagnosis against the frozen failed public run. Query the local knowledge base and inspect each cited original before deciding. Do not edit files, build, run QEMU, seal a candidate, or use private evidence. Return only schema_version=1 JSON with attribution, action, failure_run_ids, contract_ids, test_ids, changed_paths (path and implementation role), a minimal UTF-8 unified patch, pinned evidence, rationale, and temporary_diagnostics_removed. Use APPLY only for DRIVER_TRANSLATION, ADAPTED_TEST, HARNESS_PACKAGING, SOURCE_ASSUMPTION, or a necessity-backed existing TARGET_API_PLATFORM path; otherwise use BLOCKED with an empty patch and changed_paths.
